propositions: Anthropic and OpenAI usage rows fail to price when model_ref is stored as provider-qualified (e.g., anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6) because genai-prices cannot resolve the prefixed form, whereas bare model ids (e.g., claude-sonnet-4-6) resolve correctly

Bedrock rows price successfully with provider prefix (bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6) while Anthropic and OpenAI rows do not, creating an asymmetric cost comparison bias that falsely suggests Bedrock is the only measured provider
LookupError exceptions from genai-prices are caught and silently converted to unpriced rows without warning, making formatting errors indistinguishable from genuinely unknown models in output

Provider-aware id translation must be decided by registry membership rather than prefix splitting, because splitting on first colon breaks versioned AWS model ids like anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0
Cost reporting in CI provider matrix and rebar usage output omits Anthropic and OpenAI figures with no visible distinction between mis-formatted ids and unknown models
The fix must preserve best-effort pricing without breaking summarize, while making unpriced rows distinguishable by naming their unresolvable refs
